fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models

Class StandardRTAtomicModelFactory

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.AbstractAtomicModelFactory
      • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.StandardAtomicModelFactory
        • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.StandardRTAtomicModelFactory
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AtomicModelFactoryI, RTModelFactoryI, java.io.Serializable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    StandardRTAtomicHIOA_Factory

    public class StandardRTAtomicModelFactory
extends StandardAtomicModelFactory
implements RTModelFactoryI
    The class StandardRTAtomicModelFactory implements the standard model factory for real time atomic models.

    Description

    The difference with the standard atomic model factory are that the standard simulation engine to be created is AtomicRTEngine and the initialisation of the acceleration factor used during the simulation runs.

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       accelerationFactor > 0.0

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Created on : 2020-11-23

    Author:
    Jacques Malenfant
